correctness.rationale: For all real q>=9 and every integer k>=2, exact rational certificates give I1(9)>137/10000, I1(6)<109/1000, Ik(6)<1/10 and sup|Jk|<1/2. The bound Ik(6) is analytic at k>=12 using Xu and Landau; finite k handled by exact arithmetic with justified integration and tail errors. Hölder shows I1(q)>0.0137*2^(-(q-9)), while Ik(q)<0.1*2^(-(q-6)), with strict separation. The Bessel spectral theorem then implies the stated sharp mixed-norm constant and equality classes. The embedded CHECK.py was executed successfully; its finite tests supplement, rather than replace, the infinite analytic arguments.
